## Why the conversion does not land here

Two facts, both read off the tree rather than asserted:

1. `apps/agent/package.json` declares **no** `@platos/context-*` dependency. A module cannot import a contract its package has not got.
2. `scripts/arch/composition-root.mjs` names `apps/core-api/src/composition/adapter-bindings.ts` as the ONE file entitled to bind an adapter to a port, and it is **not** inside the host app. So the host app cannot construct a context either.

Together those put the reachable work at **4** call site(s) if the seam existed, and at **0** until it does. WIN-268 P3 is therefore a composition problem before it is a per-call-site one.
